children.name: Non-Transparent Bridge PCIe Port Definition
children.description: [EMBAR1XBASE, EMBAR2XBASE] Configures port as TB, NTB-NTB, or NTB-RP (DON'T SELECT NTB-RP for legacy IIO on A0 Si!)

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.name: Crosslink control Override
children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Non-Transparent Bridge PCIe Port Definition
children.description: [EMBAR1XBASE, EMBAR2XBASE] Configures port as TB, NTB-NTB, or NTB-RP (DON'T SELECT NTB-RP for legacy IIO on A0 Si!)

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: PCI-E Port
children.description: In auto mode the BIOS will remove the EXP port if there is no device or errors on that device and the device is not HP capable.  Enable/Disable is used to enable/disable the port and expose/hide its CFG space.

children.name: Hot Plug Capable
children.description: This option specifies if the link is considered Hot Plug capable.

children.name: Surprise Hot Plug Capable
children.description: This option specifies if the link is considered Surprise Hot Plug capable.

children.name: PCI-E Port Link Disable
children.description: This option disables the link so that the no training occurs but the CFG space is still active.

children.name: Link Speed
children.description: Choose Link Speed for this PCIe port

children.name: Override Max Link Width
children.description: Override the max link width that was set by bifurcation

children.name: PCI-E Port DeEmphasis
children.description: De-Emphais control (LNKCON2[6]) for this PCIe port.

children.name: PCI-E Port Clocking
children.description: Configure port clocking via LNKCON[6]. This refers to this components and the down stream component.

children.name: PCI-E Port Clock Gating
children.description: Enable/Disable Clock Gating for this PCIe port

children.name: Data Link Feature Exchange
children.description: Enable/Disable data link feature negotiation in the Data Link Feature Capabilities (DLFCAP) register.

children.name: PCI-E Port MPSS
children.description: Configure Max Payload Size Supported in PCIe Device Capabilities register.

children.name: PCI-E Port D-state
children.description: Set to D0 for normal operation, D3Hot to be in low-power state

children.name: PCI-E ASPM Support
children.description: This option enables / disables the ASPM (L1) support for the downstream devices.

children.name: PCI-E Port L1 Exit Latency
children.description: The length of time this port requires to complete transition from L1 to L0

children.name: MSI
children.description: BUS0 DEVx FUN0 OFF 0x5A bit 0, Where X is 0-3

children.name: PCI-E Extended Sync
children.description: Enable / disable the Extended Sync Mode (D:x F:0 O:7Ch B:7) where x is 0-9

children.name: PCI-E Detect Wait Time
children.description: Set PCIe port TxRx detect polling.

children.name: Compliance Mode
children.description: Enable/Disable Compliance Mode for this PCIe port

children.name: EOI
children.description: Dev 0,2,3 MISCCTRLSTS (Reg 0x188)Bit 26

children.name: Fatal Err Over
children.description: Enables forcing fatal error propagation to the IIO core error logic for this port

children.name: Non-Fatal Err Over
children.description: Enables forcing non-fatal error propagation to the IIO core error logic for this port

children.name: Corr Err Over
children.description: Enables forcing correctable error propagation to the IIO core error logic for this port

children.name: ACPI PME Interrupt
children.description: When enabled, ACPI PME Interrupts are generated from this port

children.name: P2P Memory Read
children.description: Controls Peer2Peer Memory Read Decoding

children.name: PME to ACK
children.description: Controls timeout usage for IIO waiting on PME_TO_ACK after a PME_TURN_OFF message

children.description: When Enabled _HPGPE message is generated or MSI is generated on HP event.

children.name: PM ACPI Mode
children.description: When Enabled, _HPGPE message is generated Otherwise MSI is generated on PM event.

children.description: Controls the reporting of unsupported requests that IIO itself detects on requests its receives from a PCI Express/DMI port

children.name: Non-Transparent Bridge PCIe Port Definition
children.description: [EMBAR1XBASE, EMBAR2XBASE] Configures port as TB, NTB-NTB, or NTB-RP (DON'T SELECT NTB-RP for legacy IIO on A0 Si!)

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.name: Crosslink control Override
children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Non-Transparent Bridge PCIe Port Definition
children.description: [EMBAR1XBASE, EMBAR2XBASE] Configures port as TB, NTB-NTB, or NTB-RP (DON'T SELECT NTB-RP for legacy IIO on A0 Si!)

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.name: Crosslink control Override
children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Non-Transparent Bridge PCIe Port Definition
children.description: [EMBAR1XBASE, EMBAR2XBASE] Configures port as TB, NTB-NTB, or NTB-RP (DON'T SELECT NTB-RP for legacy IIO on A0 Si!)

children.name: Enable NTB BARs
children.description: [IMBAR1] If Enabled, BIOS will program NTB BAR size registers

children.name: Enable SPLIT BARs
children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.name: Crosslink control Override
children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.description: [IMBAR2, EMBAR2SZ] If Enabled, will use two 32 bit BARs instead of 64 bit BAR

children.name: Imbar1 Size
children.description: [IMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Imbar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_0 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2_1 size on primary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Imbar2 Size
children.description: [IMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Imbar2 size on primary side of NTB.  Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar1 Size
children.description: [EMBAR1SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar1 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>.

children.name: Embar2_0 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_0 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2_1 Size
children.description: Used to set the prefetchable Embar2_1 size on Secondary side of NTB.  Value < than 12 or > 29 (39 for BIOS supporting > 4G PCI) disables BAR.

children.name: Embar2 Size
children.description: [EMBAR2SZ] Used to set the prefetchable Embar2 size on secondary side of NTB. Value range <12...51> representing BAR sizes <4KB ... 128PB>."

children.description: Configure NTB port as DSP/USP, USD/DSP, or use external pin

children.name: Non-preferred way mask
children.description:
10-bit mask used to control the bias counter ratio:

Bit 0 applies to 1st miss

Bit 1 applies to 2nd miss

...

Bit 9 applies to 10th miss and it repeats (Bit 0 applies to 11th miss and so on)

If bit X of this mask is:

0 - (n*10+X+1)th miss should be allocated in preferred way

1 – (n*10+X+1)th miss should be allocated in non-preferred way
